modes.skipped_evidence: shipped an answer while a required tool was never called (e.g. never opened the order)
modes.skipped_evidence_caught: tried to answer before the path was complete; the evidence guard sent it back
modes.fabricated_argument: an id argument that exists nowhere: not in the store, not on the ticket
modes.ungrounded_argument: a real-looking argument that disagrees with what the tools returned
modes.out_of_order: a tool called before the tool that supplies its inputs
modes.redundant_call: the same tool with the same arguments again
modes.unknown_tool: a tool name that does not exist
modes.prose_instead_of_action: a lap with neither a tool call nor a parseable answer
modes.budget_exhausted: the run ended on a budget, not an answer
modes.wrong_decision: a final decision or amount that the outcome eval fails

mitigation.description: **Re-planning on unsupported answers** (`evidence_guard=True`, `ticket_agent.unsupported_by_evidence`). When the model answers before the tools that answer depends on have returned, the loop does not accept it: it sends the answer back naming the missing tool ("You have not looked up order ORD-5001 yet. Call get_order…"), at most twice. Nothing else differs from the baseline: same model, prompt, tool descriptions, budgets and tickets.
